# Runnable CHD autogeneration proof
This is the integrated 59-operation transport/config generation package, not a deployed controller. Canonical inputs are copied from root contracts and checked for byte parity by the release gate. See `source-map.json` for origins: record schemas and logical read views remain reference projections pending G-05/G-12, not authoritative writer serializers. No commands here write to DuckBrain, Hermes, or Crier. Captured CLI/MCP catalogs are hash-bound inputs; MCP fidelity stays explicitly BLOCKED on IF-06/IF-07. A catalog load or compilation cannot clear that gate.
Requirements: Linux host with Python 3.14.9, Git, Make and a Go bootstrap executable; initial bootstrap needs network access to the pinned package/module registries. `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.27.4` selects the actual Go compiler (the host bootstrap Go may be older).
```sh make bootstrap make generate make test # In a Git checkout whose inputs and generated subtree are committed: make verify # Fresh archive with no .git: initialize a local baseline FIRST, then verify. git init git add .gitignore Makefile README.md autogen.json source-map.json go.mod go.sum requirements.lock contracts tools tests generated git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c user.name='Autogen verifier' -c user.email='autogen@example.invalid' commit -m 'Freeze candidate contract generation' make verify .venv/bin/python tools/test_drift_gate.py ```
`make generate` replaces only `generated/` after complete successful generation. `make check` builds into a temporary directory and compares exact filenames and bytes with **HEAD**, and also rejects dirty/staged/untracked changes and ignored extra generated files. It never runs `git add` or commits. `make test` exercises the generated Go validator, document round trips, and generated HTTP client → strict server loopback path plus independent lossless OpenAPI projection checks.
The OpenAPI source is unchanged; nested `$defs` are hoisted only in the derived codegen projection. The original spec is separately emitted for runtime validation. Scoped/dynamic refs are refused rather than rewritten unsafely. Strict Go server interfaces are not JSON Schema 2020-12 enforcement; runtime raw-body/response validation, authorization, idempotency, store fencing and controller behavior remain implementation obligations. Config/record types are validated raw document wrappers to retain missing/null, unions and integers. Logical-table Go structs are explicitly read views, not serializers of record. Zero physical CHD SQL tables/DDL are generated.
`generated/provenance.json` contains input hashes and derived counts, never timestamps/absolute execution paths. Generated docs are inventories/full schemas, not hand-maintained copies. `contracts/logical_tables.py` is a declarative field-catalog snapshot from the storage sibling; its proposed completions are not normative merely because they compile. Business fixtures remain independently authored evidence, not generated expected results.
